name: sheffield-offportal
intent: Off-portal sweep (2-3 beds, ≤ £325k; Norton Lees, Meersbrook and neighbours, or near Endcliffe Park): Buy the best-value semi in south Sheffield: cheap against its fundamentals (space, layout), front door into a hall, open-plan living-dining or one knock-through away, room to extend out or up. Dated interior is welcome: it gets ripped out. Refurb it fully while renting elsewhere, then live in it. Works budget up to about £250k from family loans.

vibe.summary: Semi-detached house (detached if affordable): a hallway, open-plan living-dining (or one knock-through away), garage or drive, dated interior to rip out, room to go up or out. Best areas: Norton Lees and the Meersbrook Park side of Meersbrook; Heeley, Nether Edge and the Endcliffe Park side of S11 are fine; Woodseats proper and steep, icy hills score lower. Owner-occupied streets, not a student area.
likes: big roof space or garden to extend
avoid: Woodseats proper (Woodseats edge of Norton Lees is fine)

record: scope to extend or convert loft
front door into hall or room

gates.text: In one of the search areas above.
Asking at most {price_max}; asking + 1.15W + C at most {allin_max}.
Freehold, or lease of 150+ years with no live covenant dispute.
No movement, subsidence, knotweed, spray foam, non-standard build or dry rot.

Front door opens into a hall, lobby or porch, never straight into a living, reception or dining room or kitchen. Fail if the listing text or floorplan shows it opens into a room, even if a hall could be made later. If neither shows where it opens, pass as unconfirmed and name it in the risk.

finished_spec: 3 bedrooms (2 accepted if spacious, 75 m²+ inside), open-plan living-dining with kitchen, front door into a hall, garage or drive, 85-110 m² inside.

buy_test.tax_note: Stamp duty as a first-time buyer: nil up to £300k, 5% from £300k to £500k.
buy_test.comps_sources: Rightmove sold prices, Zoopla, Land Registry via domovita / housemetric / propertyengine / doogal; Housemetric joins EPC floor areas to sales

criteria.name: Bedrooms
bands: 2 spacious + easy loft, or 3rd needs loft

criteria.name: Extension headroom (garden ≥ 10 m; loft fits; neighbours extended)
Street and area (owner-occupied, tidy, no main road; Norton Lees and Meersbrook Park side best; Woodseats proper lower)
Inside bones (light, ceiling height, scope to open up; dated decor is no penalty)
Outside (semi or detached, good brick or stone, front garden, pair hangs together)

sources.name: Rightmove
sources.desc: Rightmove (rightmove.co.uk), the biggest UK portal. Listing pages look like rightmove.co.uk/properties/<number>; sold-STC, under-offer and auction tags show on the page. WebFetch often refuses these pages: find the same house on Zoopla, OnTheMarket, PrimeLocation, the agent's site or a Rightmove brochure PDF (media.rightmove.co.uk).

sources.name: Zoopla
sources.desc: Zoopla (zoopla.co.uk; also app.zoopla.co.uk and primelocation.com, which share stock). Listing pages look like zoopla.co.uk/for-sale/details/<number>; they often show £/sq ft and floor area.

sources.name: OnTheMarket
sources.desc: OnTheMarket (onthemarket.com). Listing pages look like onthemarket.com/details/<number>.

sources.name: Jitty
sources.desc: Jitty (jitty.com), an AI portal that tags listings with floor area, £/sq ft and condition (Renovation Potential, Renovation Needed). Search pages live under jitty.com/for-sale/... and are indexed by web search. Prefer houses tagged as needing renovation, but return every qualifying house.

sources.name: Probate and executor sales
sources.desc: Houses sold by executors or as probate: search agents' own sites, auction sites and solicitors' property pages for the words probate, executor sale, deceased estate, grant of probate, no onward chain, vacant possession, in the search areas. Add flag probate when the listing says so. Use only property listings: never death notices, obituaries, funeral pages or probate registers, and never link a named person to an address. OFF-PORTAL RUN: do not search or cite Rightmove, Zoopla, PrimeLocation, OnTheMarket or Jitty; use only this source's own site and pages it links to.
